import { createHash } from "node:crypto"
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { join, resolve } from "node:path"

const workspace = resolve(import.meta.dir, "../../..")
const checkpoint = join(workspace, ".internal", "memory-reviewed.json")
const reviewed = existsSync(checkpoint)
	? JSON.parse(readFileSync(checkpoint, "utf8"))
	: {}
const files = ["MEMORY.qmd", ...new Bun.Glob("memory/**/*.{md,qmd}").scanSync({
	cwd: workspace,
	onlyFiles: true,
	followSymlinks: false
})].filter((file) => !file.startsWith("memory/_archive/"))
const changed = files.some((file) => {
	const path = join(workspace, file)
	const hash = existsSync(path)
		? createHash("sha256").update(readFileSync(path, "utf8")).digest("hex")
		: null
	return hash !== reviewed[file]
}) || Object.keys(reviewed).some((file) => !files.includes(file) && reviewed[file] !== null)
console.log(JSON.stringify({ run: changed, reason: changed ? "Memory notes changed" : "No memory changes since review" }))
